Estimated smooth functions

Source: R/smooth_plots.R
smooth_estimates.Rd

Evaluates the smooth terms (s(), te(), ...) of a model fitted by countreg() or countreg_rp() on a grid over the observed range of their variables, with pointwise and simultaneous confidence bands.

Usage

smooth_estimates(
  object,
  term = NULL,
  n = 100,
  level = 0.95,
  nsim = 10000,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

object

a fitted model with smooth terms.

term

optional term labels (as in summary(), e.g. "s(lnaadt)"); by default every smooth.

n

number of grid points for one-variable smooths (the grid of a two-variable smooth has round(sqrt(n) * 3) points per variable).

level

confidence level of the bands.

nsim

number of draws for the simultaneous bands.

seed

optional seed for those draws (the caller's random-number stream is left unchanged).

Value

A data frame with columns parameter, term, the smooth's variable(s), fit, se, lwr, upr (pointwise) and slwr, supr (simultaneous).

Details

Each smooth is shown on the scale of its linear predictor (log for the mean, the parameter's link for a distribution parameter), centered as fitted (the constant is in the intercept). Pointwise bands are \(\hat f \pm z\,SE\), with \(SE^2 = x' V x\) from the fit's covariance matrix (Bayesian by default). Simultaneous bands use the 95th (or level) percentile of \(\max |f^* - \hat f| / SE\) over the grid, for coefficient draws \(f^*\) from \(N(\hat b, V)\) (Ruppert, Wand and Carroll 2003), so they cover the whole curve with the stated probability.

References

Ruppert, D., Wand, M.P. and Carroll, R.J. (2003). Semiparametric Regression. Cambridge University Press.

See also

plot_smooths()

Examples

# \donttest{
data("washington_roads")
m <- countreg(Total_crashes ~ s(lnaadt) + offset(lnlength),
              data = washington_roads, family = "NB2")
head(smooth_estimates(m))
#>   parameter      term   lnaadt       fit        se       lwr        upr
#> 1      mean s(lnaadt) 5.796058 -2.108904 0.9008161 -3.874471 -0.3433364

#> 5      mean s(lnaadt) 5.962152 -1.687271 0.5592993 -2.783477 -0.5910644
#> 6      mean s(lnaadt) 6.003675 -1.583175 0.4855303 -2.534797 -0.6315527
